title: Chatticus deploys ChatticusComputers in the customer account
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing — `chatticus-2f2d87` documented the live refuse
- **Unblocks:** `chatticus-3e72dc` (terminal, browser, files, approvals, spend, relocate) and any honest claim that a customer computer starts

---

## Why this exists

F-computer (`chatticus-2f2d87`) live on development: ComputerWorker **assumed** `ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole` in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID`, then `DescribeStacks(ChatticusComputers)` failed because that stack is not deployed in the customer account. **Zero `RunTask` in both accounts.** Anthus `ChatticusComputers` desiredCount stayed 0. Refuse-not-fallback held.

The published role allows `cloudformation:CreateStack` / `UpdateStack` / `DescribeStacks` on `stack/ChatticusComputers*/*`, plus ECS, ECR, VPC, logs, and `iam:CreateRole` for `ChatticusComputers*`. This card's product path CreateStacks **ChatticusComputers** under that role. **Do not** put an `AWS::S3::Bucket` in that template — the role has no `s3:*` (`grep -c s3: infra/customer-role.yml` is 0). The bucket is `chatticus-bb9084`.

## Who creates what (do not rediscover)

| Asset | Who | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cross-account IAM role | Customer | Published template (done, unmodified) |
| `ChatticusComputers` (VPC, cluster, task def, ECR repo, logs, task role) | **Chatticus under the assumed role** | `CreateStack` already in the published policy |
| Computer image `:dev` in that ECR | **Chatticus under the assumed role** | `PutImage` already allowed; customer does not docker-push |
| Snapshot bucket in the customer account | **Customer, in the published CloudFormation template** (`chatticus-bb9084`) | `infra/customer-role.yml` has **zero** `s3:` actions. CFN creates resources with the **caller's** credentials; `ChatticusComputers*` only names which stacks the role may touch. An assumed-role `AWS::S3::Bucket` inside `ChatticusComputers` fails AccessDenied. Decision 2026-09-07: declare the bucket in the customer-run template (reviewable before they agree). The assumed role then needs only read/write on that named bucket — not `s3:CreateBucket`. Anthus `ChatticusSnapshots` serves Anthus-managed orgs only. |

Do **not** ask the customer to run a second template for `ChatticusComputers`. Do **not** `cdk deploy` Anthus `ChatticusComputers` into the customer account from the Anthus CLI. Do **not** `cdk deploy --all`. Do **not** destroy Anthus `ChatticusSnapshots` or `ChatticusComputers`. Do **not** `members seed`. Anthus desiredCount stays 0.

## Live constraints from `2f2d87`

- Map `DescribeStacks` `ClientError` (missing stack) to `OrganizationComputerProvisioningError` so ComputerWorker logs the reason (today nack swallows the body).
- Kernel `enqueue_computer_continuation` is the labeled operator path to reach ComputerWorker while the host is stopped. `POST .../resume` while stopped is `ComputerNotReadyError` — do not treat that as this card.
- Test human messages via kernel `post_channel_message` (live SQS). Do not wait on the UI.

## Done when

`ChatticusComputers` exists in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID` because Chatticus created it under the assumed role; the `:dev` image is in that account's ECR; one computer-requiring turn reaches **customer-account `RunTask`**; Anthus `RunTask` count stays 0 and Anthus desiredCount stays 0. If the published **role** needs a new action for Computers (not S3), stop and record it on `chatticus-8a25af` — do not silent-edit `customer-role.yml`. Snapshot `s3:` and the bucket itself are `chatticus-bb9084`.

comments.text:
Plan reviewed, **not authorized**. Worktree `/tmp/chatticus-82dab7-customer-computers` on `feat/customer-computers-stack-82dab7` is correct (not the primary clone, at `cc8eaf6`). Lazy one-shot inside `OrganizationComputerHostStarter`, Gherkin-first, refuse-not-fallback, and the 8a25af STOP rule stand.

Holes to close before implement (inversion):

1. **Do not put an S3 bucket in this slice’s template.** `customer-role.yml` has no `s3:*`. CreateStack of a bucket will `CREATE_FAILED`. 82dab7 DoD is customer `RunTask`, not hydrate. Omit the bucket; ephemeral live root. Bucket + `s3:*` is a customer-visible follow-up on `8a25af` before the file-actions row of `3e72dc`. Do not wait for a live failure to discover a hole we can read in the YAML now.

2. **Do not copy `:dev` layers through the 60s ComputerWorker Lambda.** Chromium image will not finish in one (or many) 60s nacks. Customer task definition pulls **Anthus** `:dev`. Anthus ECR repo policy allows the customer execution role (Anthus-side, not customer-visible). Customer ECR replica is out of this card. Live preflight: Anthus `:dev` already exists (`computer/push-computer-image.sh`); if missing, that is an Anthus ops stop, not a customer copy.

3. **`CreateStack` TemplateBody max is 51,200 bytes.** A CDK VPC+ECS template often exceeds it. After synth, measure. Over the limit: `TemplateURL` to an Anthus **S3 object URL** (CFN cannot fetch CloudFront — that is why customer-role is GET then `--template-body`). Under the limit: `TemplateBody` is fine. CI must fail if synth drifts from the committed artifact.

4. **`CreateStack` must pass `CAPABILITY_IAM` and `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`.** Omitted from the plan; IAM roles are in the stack.

5. **No production auto-provision flag.** Scenario 3 is a Gherkin fake that cannot `CreateStack` (test double), not `CHATTICUS_*_AUTOPROVISION=0` in Lambda. Two products is a defect.

Revise PLAN.md in the existing worktree. Do not implement. Do not CreateStack. Do not edit `customer-role.yml`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
## The snapshot-bucket row will fail as written (2026-09-07)

The **who creates what** table says the snapshot bucket is created by *"Chatticus, inside `ChatticusComputers`"*. That cannot work with the published role.

```
grep -c 's3:' infra/customer-role.yml  ->  0
```

**The role has zero `s3:` actions.** CloudFormation creates resources with the **caller's** permissions, so a `CreateStack`/`UpdateStack` carrying an `AWS::S3::Bucket` will fail access-denied on the bucket, regardless of the stack name matching `ChatticusComputers*`. The `ChatticusComputers*` resource filter governs which *stacks* the role may touch, not which *resource types* it may create inside them.

**So the template changes either way.** The card avoids a customer-run bucket partly to avoid a second template and a customer-visible change — but S3 permissions must be added to `infra/customer-role.yml` no matter which path is taken. That is a customer-visible change by `chatticus-8a25af`'s rule. Given it is unavoidable, choose on merit rather than on avoiding it.

**Decision made 2026-09-07: the bucket is declared in the customer-run template.** See `chatticus-bb9084`. Reasoning:

- The customer can **read what they are agreeing to** before running it — the standard `8a25af` sets. A bucket deployed later under an assumed role is not reviewable in advance.
- It keeps **`s3:CreateBucket` off the Anthus role entirely**. The role needs only read/write on one named bucket — a far narrower ask of a security team than "may create buckets in your account".
- No first-run race: the bucket exists before the first hydrate or publish.
- Teardown and lifecycle belong to the customer's stack, with encryption, versioning and block-public-access declared and reviewable.

**This does not change the rest of the table.** `ChatticusComputers` (VPC, cluster, task def, ECR, logs, task role) and the `:dev` image stay Chatticus-deployed under the assumed role, as recorded. Only the bucket row moves.

Open sub-questions are on `bb9084` — bucket naming from `OrganizationId`, `DeletionPolicy` (`Retain` recommended: deleting a customer's files as a side effect of removing an IAM role would be indefensible), region pinning, and whether the `tenants/{tenant_id}` prefix is still wanted with one bucket per organization.

comments.text:
## Live proof after #316: FAIL — `RUNTASK_USER_ID_NONE`

ThinTurn development deploy of `6457a30` (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/actions/runs/34158002739). Lab IAM user, not root.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Stack | `UPDATE_COMPLETE` |
| Subnet/SG outputs | Present (2 subnets + SG) |
| Product UpdateStack after deploy | 1 success |
| Customer `RunTask` | **0** |
| Anthus `RunTask` / desiredCount | **0** / **0** |
| Nack `reason=` | Yes (#316 logging holds) |

`#316` did what it claimed. `start_host` now reaches `ecs.run_task`; boto3 rejects overrides:

`Invalid type for parameter overrides.containerOverrides[0].environment[1].value, value: None`

`environment[1]` is `CHATTICUS_USER_ID`. `HostStartClaim.user_id` is `None` because `ComputerWorker._dispatch_host_start_if_needed` calls `request_computer_host_start(tenant_id, turn_id)` with the default `user_id=None`.

Do not close. Next slice: pass a real string `user_id` on the computer-continuation host-start path. Do **not** add S3 to `ChatticusComputers`. Do **not** silent-edit the published role.
